# P1.4: host /proc and /tmp remain visible; private scratch and covers change df.
df -h → DEV-SHM
# NETLINK_SOCK_DIAG denial uses procfs; interface suffixes and diagnostic detail are absent.
# Procfs also lacks v6only: [::] endpoints become *, but IPv6 socket rows remain.
ss -tuna → SS-PROCFS-V6ONLY
# With argv[0] overridden, pidof <absolute-exe-path>'s fallback cannot read an outside /proc/<pid>/exe across
# the user namespace (ptrace access check). argv[0] matching is separate; pgrep -x
# still resolves the same unique comm. Only exit 1 with empty output is accepted.
pidof executable → PIDOF-EXE-DENIED
